note: A2GLASS (Glass sphere automation second pass): blocks for the printed Faultline Mark reactions that were GM riders.

TAL_GLASS_BREAK_THE_PROUD_WEAPON.why: A marked creature's weapon hit: the printed Strength saving throw, the fracture (Disadvantage on its next roll with that weapon or limb) or the Successful Save's damage reduction (combat/ext/glass_faults.py).

TAL_GLASS_SPELL_LINE_CRACK.why: A marked creature seen through a Glass Surface uses a spell, CP or supernatural feature: the printed Wisdom saving throw and its four answers (combat/ext/glass_faults.py).

TAL_GLASS_FLAW_WITHIN_THE_GOLDEN_TECHNIQ.why: A marked creature uses a high-cost feature within 60 feet: the printed Wisdom saving throw and its four answers (combat/ext/glass_faults.py).
